decision: Use pinned Playwright and axe-core development dependencies for clone-local browser, responsive, and WCAG verification.
purpose: The central verification policy requires executed browser E2E, axe, keyboard, and horizontal-overflow evidence that the Flask unit suite cannot provide.
maintenance: Both projects are actively maintained upstream and are checked by the weekly npm and GitHub advisory workflow.

licenses.axe-core: MPL-2.0 reviewed and accepted for test-only use; it is not shipped in the runtime image.

security_and_size: The dependencies execute only in verification. node_modules, browsers, tests, reports, and npm caches stay outside the runtime Docker context and image.
alternatives: Manual-only browser checks would not be reproducible; browser automation without axe-core would not provide the required accessibility engine.
removal_plan: Remove these dependencies if the central kit supplies an equivalent pinned browser and accessibility harness, preserving the same checks and evidence.
